Fix the cervical spine using an improvised cervical splint (collar). Apply a sterile cotton swab to the wound and place the victim on his back with his legs raised. If possible, apply cold to the head
Do not apply a cervical splint, seal the wound with a medical plaster, lay the victim on his side

questions.comment: Traumatic brain injury with injury to the scalp may be accompanied by life-threatening bleeding that does not appear to be profuse. It should be stopped by direct pressure on the wound, and then a pressure bandage should be applied. In case of loss of consciousness, the victim is given a stable lateral position. Apply cold to the head to slow down the development of cerebral edema.

questions.question: What vehicles are classified as route vehicles?

answers.text: Buses, trolleybuses, trams used for regular transportation of passengers and luggage, moving along a set route with designated stopping places
Any vehicles carrying passengers and luggage moving along a route with stops

questions.comment: Route vehicles include buses, trolleybuses, trams, used for regular transportation of passengers and luggage, moving along a set route with designated stopping places. (Clause 1.2 of the Traffic Regulations, the term “Route vehicles”)

questions.question: When moving in a populated area, you can continue driving:

answers.text: In any of the directions indicated

questions.comment: Sign 4.1.4 “Move straight or to the right” extends its effect to the first intersection of the roadways in front of which it is installed. Route vehicles may deviate from the effect of the sign. Therefore, marking 1.11 (solid line with broken line) does not matter for you. (Whether it exists or not, for example, it is covered with snow). You are not allowed to turn around along trajectory “B”. You cannot make a right turn either, because you are not on the far right lane, you can only continue moving in direction “B.” (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Does this sign indicate?

answers.text: Distance to the end of the tunnel
Direction of movement to the emergency exit and distance to it

questions.comment: The tunnel has a new road sign 6.21.1 “Direction to the emergency exit.” It indicates the direction of movement to the emergency exit and the distance to it. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: To what extent does this sign apply?

answers.text: To the nearest intersection in the direction of travel
To the place where the sign “End of the maximum speed limit zone” is installed
To the end of the village

questions.comment: The effect of sign 5.31 “Zone with maximum speed limit” is canceled only by sign 5.32 “End of zone with maximum speed limit”. ("Road Signs")

questions.question: These markings on the traffic lane:

answers.text: Provides you with an advantage when rearranging to the right lane
Informs you that the road turns right
Warns you that you are approaching a narrowing of the carriageway

questions.comment: Marking 1.19 warns of approaching a narrowing of the roadway (the number of traffic lanes in a given direction is decreasing). (“Horizontal marking”).

questions.question: It is prohibited to overtake a vehicle that has special color schemes applied to its external surfaces:

answers.text: Only when a special sound signal is turned on
Only when blue (blue and red) flashing lights are turned on
If both of the above conditions are present

questions.comment: Mandatory conditions for the prohibition of overtaking the “operative” (and the T.S. accompanied by him) are: 1 – special colorographic schemes applied to the external surfaces; 2 – turning on blue or blue and red flashing lights on it; 3 – activation of the alarm sound signal. The correct answer is if all conditions are met. (Clause 3.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you required to give a right turn signal in this situation?
questions.comment: You will be rebuilt. Before changing lanes, you should give a right turn signal. (“Road signs”, “Horizontal markings” 1.19, clause 8.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Which trajectory are you allowed to turn right?
questions.comment: When turning right, the vehicle should move as close as possible to the right edge of the roadway. You have such an opportunity; when turning right, continue driving along trajectory “A”. (Clause 8.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You can perform a reversal:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: U-turns are prohibited at pedestrian crossings (trajectories “B”). You can do it before or behind the pedestrian crossing, in this case along the “A” or “B” trajectory. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: In what cases is it permissible to drive outside the right lane if you are driving a vehicle whose speed, for technical reasons, cannot be more than 40 km/h?

answers.text: Only when changing lanes before turning left or making a U-turn
In all of the above cases

questions.comment: Vehicles whose speed should not exceed 40 km/h or which, for technical reasons, cannot reach such a speed, must move in the extreme right lane, except in cases of detour, overtaking or changing lanes before turning left, making a U-turn or stopping in permitted cases on the left side of the road. The correct answer is in all of the above cases. (Clause 9.5 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken:

answers.text: Must move as far to the right as possible
Must not impede overtaking by increasing speed or other actions

questions.comment: The driver of an overtaken vehicle is prohibited from preventing overtaking by increasing the speed or other actions. (Clause 11.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which driver violated the parking rules?

answers.text: Only the driver of car A
Only the driver of car B

questions.comment: Parking is prohibited closer than 50 m from railway crossings. Both drivers are violators, since the distance is less than required. (Clause 12.5 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: When turning right, are you required to give way to a car making a U-turn?
questions.comment: When driving “under an additional section” that is turned on simultaneously with the main red traffic light, you are obliged to give way to ALL moving from other directions, regardless of their further direction of movement. (Clause 13.5 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: In what case do you have the right to pass the intersection first?

answers.text: When driving straight, left and in the opposite direction

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. There is an obstacle on the right side of the driver of a car. You pass the intersection first when driving straight and to the left. When turning, there will be an obstacle on your right. (Clause 13.11 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to continue straight ahead. When the traffic light is flashing yellow, you should:

answers.text: Give way only to the tram

questions.comment: When the traffic light is flashing yellow, the intersection is unregulated. According to the priority signs - unequal. Vehicles on the main road have priority. You pass first, without yielding to anyone, since the tram and truck are on a secondary road. (Clause 13.3, 13.9 of traffic rules)

questions.question: What is the maximum speed limit for vehicles in residential zones, bicycle zones and courtyard areas?
questions.comment: Movement in residential areas and courtyard areas has a number of restrictions. Such restrictions also include speed, which should not exceed 20 km/h. (Clause 10.2 of traffic rules)

questions.question: When driving at night outside populated areas, you must use:
questions.comment: On all mechanical vehicles, high or low beam headlights must be turned on in the dark and in conditions of poor visibility (Clause 19.1 of the Traffic Regulations). The high beam must be switched to low beam in accordance with Clause 19.2 of the Traffic Regulations.
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: In what cases are drivers held criminally liable for violations of the Rules that lead to serious consequences?

answers.text: Only when causing death to a person
When causing death to a person or serious harm to human health
If there is a victim (regardless of the severity of the injuries he received) or major material damage has been caused

questions.comment: According to Art. 264 of the Criminal Code of the Russian Federation, drivers are held criminally liable for violations of traffic rules and operating rules. when causing death to a person or serious harm to human health. “Criminal Code of the Russian Federation”.

questions.question: If you stop on an uphill (downhill) slope and there is a sidewalk, you can prevent the vehicle from rolling away spontaneously by turning its front wheels to the following position:
questions.comment: To prevent the vehicle from unintentionally rolling, turn the wheels so that they rest against the sidewalk curb. This prevents further movement of the car (“A” and “B”). And, conversely, in the absence of support, the car may spontaneously roll onto the roadway (“B” and “D”). This measure is additional to mandatory measures, i.e. using the parking brake and preferably engaging a lower gear or reverse gear. (Clause 12.8 of the Traffic Regulations. “Commentary on the Traffic Regulations of the Russian Federation,” publishing house “Za Rulem”)

questions.question: What distance will the vehicle travel in a time equal to the average reaction time of the driver at a speed of about 90 km/h?
questions.comment: The car's speedometer does not show an absolutely accurate speed value. If the speedometer speed is about 90 km/h, which is equivalent to 90,000 meters/hour or 90,000 meters: 3,600 seconds = approximately 25 meters in 1 second.

questions.question: In what cases can the owner of a passenger car transfer control of this vehicle in his presence to another person, having an insurance policy of compulsory civil liability insurance on paper or in the form of an electronic document or a copy thereof on paper?

answers.text: If this person has a driver’s license for the right to drive a vehicle of subcategory “B1”
If this person has a driver’s license to drive a category “B” vehicle
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: According to Article 25, paragraph 1 of the Federal Law “On Road Safety”, the owner of a passenger car can transfer control of this vehicle in his presence to another person, having the appropriate insurance policy on paper or in the form of an electronic document or a copy thereof on paper, if this person has a driver’s license for the right to drive a category “B” vehicle.

questions.question: This sign:

answers.text: Warns you about the presence of a narrow section of road, but does not set the order of traffic
Prohibits you from crossing the bridge
Obliges you to give way to oncoming traffic

questions.comment: Sign 2.6 “Right of way for oncoming traffic” prohibits driving onto a narrow section of the road if this may impede oncoming traffic. Therefore, you should give way to a truck approaching the bridge. (“Road signs”, paragraph 1.2, the term “Give way”)

questions.question: In what directions can you continue moving at the intersection?

answers.text: Only left and in the opposite direction

questions.comment: Sign 5.13.2 “Entering a road with a lane for route vehicles” prohibits turning right. Therefore, you can continue driving straight, left, or turn around to drive in the opposite direction. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs permit the movement of mopeds?
questions.comment: The following signs prohibit movement on mopeds: A – 5.1 “Motorway”; B – 5.3 “Road for cars”; D – 3.9 “Movement on bicycles is prohibited” prohibits the movement of bicycles and mopeds. Sign B – 3.5 “Motorcycles prohibited” prohibits the movement of motorcycles with or without a side trailer. On mopeds, driving under this sign is permitted. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Movement is permitted:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: Horizontal marking line 1.11 is allowed to be crossed from the broken side, as well as from the solid side, but only when overtaking or detour is completed. Driver “A” leaving the yard violates the Rules. A vehicle making a U-turn along trajectory “B” is allowed to move (“Horizontal marking”)

questions.question: What is the significance of the whistle signal given by the traffic controller?

answers.text: The signal is given to attract the attention of traffic participants

questions.comment: An additional whistle signal is given to attract the attention of traffic participants. (Clause 6.12 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: You intend to turn left at this intersection. At what point should the left turn signals be turned on?

answers.text: In advance, before entering the intersection
After entering the first intersection of carriageways

questions.comment: The rules require you to warn other road users in advance of a change of intent in traffic. The signal you give should not mislead other drivers. In the situation under consideration, it is necessary to turn on the direction indicator after entering the first intersection of the carriageways.(Clauses 8.1, 8.2 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Who must give way when changing lanes at the same time?

answers.text: In this situation, drivers should act by mutual agreement

questions.comment: When changing lanes at the same time, drivers are guided by the “right-hand rule.” Interference with the driver of a car. He gives way. (Clause 8.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn on the bridge along the specified trajectory?

answers.text: Allowed only when road visibility is at least 100 m

questions.comment: U-turns on bridges are prohibited. (Clause 8.11 of traffic rules)

questions.question: At what speed do you have the right to continue driving in a populated area in the right lane?

answers.text: Not less than 40 km/h and not more than 60 km/h

questions.comment: The minimum speed limit according to the plate applies only to the left lane. On the right lane, the usual speed mode for settlements is carried out – no more than 60 km/h.("Road Signs", clause 10.2 of the SDA)

questions.question: Are you allowed to overtake in this situation?

answers.text: Allowed if overtaking is completed before the intersection

questions.comment: Warning sign 1.6 "Crossing of equivalent roads" is installed outside the settlement 150-300 m before the intersection. Overtaking is prohibited at such intersections. You can overtake in the shown situation, but it must be completed before the border of the intersection.("Traffic Signs", clause 11.4 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Can you park your car at the specified location?

answers.text: Yes, if you live or work in the area indicated by the sign.

questions.comment: The action takes place in a populated area on a road that has one lane for traffic in each direction, without tram tracks in the middle. On such roads, as an exception, stopping and parking on the left side of the road in the direction of travel is allowed. But sign 5.27 “Zone with parking restrictions,” unlike sign 3.28 “Parking prohibited,” extends to the entire territory (road section), and its effect is not interrupted until sign 5.28 “End of zone with parking restrictions.” Parking is prohibited on this section of the road. (“Road signs,” clause 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to turn right. What are your actions?

answers.text: Turn right without giving way to pedestrians
Turn right, giving way to pedestrians
Stop before the intersection and wait for another signal from the traffic controller

questions.comment: The traffic controller’s arms are lowered (“Chest, back – wall”). From the right and left sides, trackless vehicles are allowed to move straight and to the right, pedestrians are allowed to cross the roadway. (Clause 6.10 of the Traffic Regulations). When turning right, you are required to give way to pedestrians crossing the roadway you are turning onto. (Clause 13.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: When driving in which direction should you give way to a car with a flashing light and a special sound signal on?
questions.comment: You are obliged to ensure unimpeded passage of the intersection for the “operative” with special signals turned on, regardless of the direction of his movement. This must be done when driving in any direction. (Clause 3.1, 3.2 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to continue straight ahead. What to do when the traffic light is flashing yellow?

answers.text: Give way only to the tram

questions.comment: When the traffic light is flashing yellow, the intersection is unregulated and unequal. The main road changes direction. Advantage is given to vehicles located on the main road, which among themselves are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. You have an obstacle on the right, give way only to a passenger car. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 13.3, 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is practice driving allowed on the motorway?

answers.text: Allowed only in the far right lane

questions.comment: Driving practice on roads marked with sign 5.1 “Highway” and intended for driving at high speeds has been permitted since 2020. (Clause 16.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When driving at night on unlit sections of roads, you can use fog lights:

answers.text: Only separately from low or high beam headlights
Only in combination with low or high beam headlights
Both separately and together with low or high beam headlights

questions.comment: At night, high or low beam headlights must be turned on on unlit sections of roads. Fog lights can only be turned on in addition to the main lighting. (Clause 19.4 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: What malfunction of the brake system prevents the vehicle from being used?

answers.text: Parking brake warning light does not turn on
The parking brake system does not ensure that the vehicle remains stationary with a full load on a slope of up to 16% inclusive.

questions.comment: It is prohibited to operate a vehicle if the parking brake system does not ensure that vehicles are stationary with a full load on a slope of up to 16 percent inclusive. (“List of faults” clause 1.9, “Technical Regulations”)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: A method of turning around using the adjacent territory on the right, ensuring traffic safety, is shown:
questions.comment: In the left picture, when leaving the adjacent territory, you look at the intersection of roadways in the usual manner. In the right picture, you must move in reverse across the intersection of roadways, which requires more time and limits visibility.

questions.question: How should the victim be positioned if he loses consciousness and has breathing and circulation to provide first aid?

answers.text: On your back with a cushion under your head
On your back with legs extended
Place the victim in a stable side position so that the knees are bent on the ground and the top hand is under the cheek

questions.comment: By the presence of breathing and signs of blood circulation, we understand that the victim is alive. But he may die of suffocation as a result of the stagnation of the tongue. It should be given a stable lateral position so that the bent knees rest against the ground and the upper arm is under the cheek.

questions.question: Do the driver's actions comply with the Rules if he is driving in the middle of the road?

answers.text: Compliant if there are no oncoming vehicles

questions.comment: The driver must occupy the side of the road intended for traffic in a given direction. Since we drive on the right, he must take the right side of the road. Driving in the middle of the road is a violation. (Clause 1.4, 9.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should you do if you need to turn around?

answers.text: Turn around at this intersection if there are no other vehicles at it
Drive straight and turn around at the intersection
Drive straight and turn around only at the next intersection

questions.comment: The effect of sign 4.1.1 “Move straight”, installed before the intersection of roadways, extends to the first intersection behind the sign. In this case, it applies to the entire intersection. Therefore, if you decide to turn around, you have no choice but to drive through the intersection and turn around on the section of road that follows, i.e. behind the intersection. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to park in the indicated location?

answers.text: Allowed only with activated hazard warning lights

questions.comment: The coverage area of ​​sign 3.27 “No stopping” in this situation is from the installation site to the nearest intersection. There is also a break in the dividing strip for turning around. Parking in the indicated place is prohibited. (“Road signs”, paragraph 1.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: This plate extends the effect of the sign installed with it:

answers.text: For passenger cars and trucks with a permissible maximum weight of not more than 3.5 tons

questions.comment: Table 8.4.3 “Type of vehicle” applies the sign to passenger cars, as well as trucks with r.m.m. up to 3.5 t. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which pedestrian crossing does this marking indicate?
questions.comment: Marking 1.14.1 (“zebra”), using a yellow background, in order to enhance its perception by drivers and, accordingly, increase the safety of pedestrians, is often used. It can designate any pedestrian crossing - both regulated and unregulated. (“Road markings”)

questions.question: What are your actions in this situation?

answers.text: Pass the crossing, making sure there is no approaching train
Stop at the traffic light and then pass the crossing
Wait until the white-lunar flashing signal turns off and pass the crossing

questions.comment: This white-moon flashing traffic light signal is equivalent to the green signal of a regular traffic light. It allows the movement of vehicles through the railway crossing. Pass the crossing, making sure that there is no approaching train. (Clause 6.9 of traffic rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: When can the hand signal for a turn be stopped?

answers.text: Immediately before the start of the maneuver
After the start of the maneuver
Only after the end of the maneuver

questions.comment: The hand signal can be completed just before the maneuver. At the same time, the signal should not mislead other road users.(Clause 8.2 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: From which lane is it allowed to enter this intersection?
questions.comment: As an exception, entry to an intersection with a roundabout can be done from any lane in that direction. Departure from the intersection is carried out according to the general rules. (Clause 8.5 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn on this section of the road?

answers.text: Permitted only when road visibility is at least 100 m

questions.comment: There's a turn ahead. Houses and trees limit the view of the road. A turn is possible only if the road in the direction of travel is visible at a distance of at least 100 m. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: At what maximum speed do you have the right to continue driving a car?
questions.comment: The name of the settlement is indicated by a sign with a blue background. This means that on this section of the road the clauses of the Rules that establish the rules of movement in populated areas do not apply. You can continue driving at a speed of no more than 90 km/h (“Road signs”, clause 10.3 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: How many vehicles can you overtake at the same time after passing through a pedestrian crossing?
questions.comment: The rules do not stipulate the number of vehicles overtaken. It is forbidden to overtake at pedestrian crossings. There are no factors prohibiting overtaking. You can overtake all three vehicles. But it should always be remembered that overtaking is a classic type of driver risk.(Clauses 1.2, 11.1, 11.4 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop on the bridge to pick up a passenger?

answers.text: Allowed only if you are driving a taxi

questions.comment: Stopping is prohibited on bridges, overpasses and overpasses that have less than three lanes for traffic in a given direction. In this situation, there are two lanes of traffic, therefore, if you stop, you will be violating the Rules. Attention! Do not confuse this question with a similar one (ticket 14, question 12), where there are three lanes. (Clause 12.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: In this situation, you are not required to give way to the tram when moving:
questions.comment: The intersection is adjustable. A traffic light with a single-color signal, intended for route vehicles, allows straight ahead traffic. A tram turning right waits for the signal to change. The green traffic light allows you to move - drive straight through the intersection first. (Clause 6.2, 6.8 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which driver making a turn must give way to pedestrians?
questions.comment: When turning right or left when passing through intersections, both regulated and unregulated, the driver is obliged to give way to pedestrians crossing the roadway onto which he is turning. Both drivers give way to pedestrians. (Clause 13.1 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Can you start turning left in this situation?

answers.text: You can, only after making sure that you do not interfere with an oncoming car making a left turn.

questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. Vehicles on the main road have priority. But since your trajectory does not intersect with the truck, you can move through the intersection at the same time, while you must take into account the advantage of the truck, i.e. do not interfere with him. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 1.2, the term “Give way”, 13.9 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to change lanes to the right in a passenger car in order to continue driving in a straight direction?

answers.text: Permitted if you do not interfere with the movement of route vehicles
Allowed if you are driving a taxi

questions.comment: According to sign 5.14.1 “Lane for route vehicles” and marking 1.23.1 (in the form of the letter “A”), the right lane belongs to route vehicles and vehicles used as passenger taxis, as well as cyclists and “school buses”. It is prohibited for other vehicles to drive or stop in this lane. The only exception is stopping to pick up and disembark passengers, as well as entering this lane when entering the road and when turning for a preliminary change of lanes, if this lane is separated from the rest of the roadway by a broken marking line. You can change lanes along the indicated path and continue moving in the forward direction if you are driving a passenger taxi. (Clause 18.2 of the Traffic Regulations, “Horizontal markings” 1.23.1)

questions.question: Rear fog lights can be used:

answers.text: Only when driving in the dark
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: Rear fog lights can only be used in conditions of poor visibility. (Clause 19.7 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: In the event of any malfunction, the further movement of the vehicle is prohibited even to the place of repair or parking?
questions.comment: If the steering system is faulty, movement poses a clear danger and is therefore prohibited. (Clause 2.3.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: While moving in a straight direction, you suddenly find yourself on a small section of slippery road. What should I do?

answers.text: Rotate the steering wheel to drive off this stretch of road
Do not change the trajectory and speed of movement

questions.comment: If this is a really small section of the road, then it is necessary not to change the trajectory and speed in order to avoid skidding.

questions.question: For how long can a hemostatic tourniquet be applied?

answers.text: No more than half an hour in the warm season and no more than one hour in the cold season
No more than one hour in the warm season and no more than half an hour in the cold season
The time for applying the tourniquet is not limited

questions.comment: A hemostatic tourniquet is applied: in the warm season (+4°C and above) - for a period of no more than one hour, and for a period of no more than half an hour in the cold season (below +4°C).

questions.question: What does the term "Limited Visibility" mean?

answers.text: The driver's visibility of the road, limited by the terrain, geometric parameters of the road, vegetation, buildings, structures or other objects
Driver visibility of the road is less than 300 m in conditions of fog, rain, snowfall, and also at dusk
Driver visibility of the road is less than 150 m at night
Driver visibility of the road in all of the above cases

questions.comment: “Limited visibility” - the driver’s visibility of the road in the direction of travel, limited by the terrain, geometric parameters of the road, vegetation, buildings, structures or other objects, including vehicles. (Clause 1.2 of the traffic rules, the term “Limited visibility”)

questions.question: What these signs warn you about:

answers.text: Stopping vehicles on the side of the road is prohibited
Driving to the side of the road is dangerous due to road works being carried out on it
Parking is prohibited at the road work site

questions.comment: Sign 1.25 “Road Works” in combination with plate 8.12 “Dangerous Shoulder” warns drivers that driving onto the side of the road is dangerous due to road (repair) work being carried out on it. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs permit the movement of trucks with a permissible maximum weight of not more than 3.5 tons?
questions.comment: Of these signs, only sign “B” - 3.1 “Entry prohibited” - prohibits the entry of all vehicles. Route vehicles deviate from the requirements of the sign: trams, trolleybuses, buses, as well as those marked with signs 8.4.1 - 8.4.8; 8.5.1, 8.5.2, 8.5.3, 8.5.4, 8.5.5 - 8.5.7 and 8.4.9 - 8.4.16. Sign "A" - 5.3 "Road for cars" - indicating a road intended only for cars (without restrictions), buses and motorcycles, any weight requirements, etc. does not present the listed vehicles. Sign “B” - 3.4 “Movement of trucks is prohibited” - in the absence of a number on the vehicle of the sign, it means that trucks can pass under the sign only if their r.m.m. no more than 3.5 tons. The correct answer is A and B. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: You can continue driving in the leftmost lane in a passenger car:
questions.comment: If there are signs organizing the direction of movement along the lanes (5.15.2), in this situation, driving straight, left and turning in the opposite direction is allowed from the far left lane. A U-turn is automatically added to a left turn, but only from the leftmost lane. (“Road signs” 5.15.2)

questions.question: In which of the indicated places are you allowed to cross the solid marking line and stop?

answers.text: In the indicated places it is prohibited to cross the solid marking line

questions.comment: The dividing strip is not intended for the movement and stopping of vehicles. (Place “A”). At place “B” - you can stop. Marking line 1.2 in this case indicates the edge of the roadway bordering the shoulder. In such a situation, it is allowed to cross it to stop the vehicle on the side of the road and when leaving it in places where stopping or parking is permitted. (Clause 1.2, the term “Dividing strip”, “Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: Do you have to stop at the request of the traffic controller at the place indicated by him?

answers.text: Must only be entered onto the sidewalk

questions.comment: The traffic controller decided to stop you. In this case, his actions must be clear and specific. Initially, he must give you instructions to stop, i.e. the gesture of his hand should be directed towards your vehicle. After this, the traffic controller indicates the stopping place. Your task is to stop at the indicated place, even if it is contrary to the stopping rules. As in this situation, stopping at the sidewalk. (Clause 6.11 of the traffic rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: This hand signal from the motorcycle driver informs you:

answers.text: About his intention to turn left or make a U-turn
About his intention to continue moving straight or left
About the presence of a vehicle approaching from the left

questions.comment: The signal for a left turn (turn) corresponds to the left hand extended to the side. The right outstretched arm, but bent at the elbow at a right angle upward, can also be used for such a signal. (Clause 8.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: On what trajectory are you allowed to make a left turn?
questions.comment: According to sign 5.7.2 “Entering a one-way road,” at this intersection you can continue moving straight, left, and make a U-turn. On a one-way road, you can drive in any lane. Therefore, you are allowed to move along any of the indicated trajectories. (“Road signs”, paragraph 8.6 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Can you turn around in this place?
questions.comment: The plate under the sign 8.2.1 “Area of ​​Action” indicates the length of the dangerous turns that the sign 1.12.1 “Dangerous turns” warns about, and which is installed outside populated areas 150 - 300 m before the dangerous area. Before turning, reduce the speed, if necessary, engage a lower gear, and when driving through a turn, do not sharply increase the speed or brake
Any of the following actions are allowed

questions.comment: To prevent the occurrence of a skid when driving through a sharp turn, which occurs with the help of centrifugal force, it is necessary, before entering the turn, to take the correct position of the vehicle on the roadway so that the trajectory of movement in the turn passes along a larger radius of curvature, reduce the speed (by approximately 1/3), if necessary, engage a lower gear, and when driving through a turn, do not sharply increase the speed and do not brake. (Driving School of the Russian Federation, Driving Techniques)

questions.question: Is it allowed to give medications to the victim when providing first aid?
questions.comment: The correct answer is forbidden. According to the current legislation, drugs are prohibited to use in first aid, so they are absent in the car first aid kit, and the victim, who may be unconscious, will have no swallowing reflex.

answers.text: In both pictures the road with a dividing strip is not shown

questions.question: The signals of such a traffic light are distributed:

answers.text: On trams, as well as other vehicles moving in the lane for route vehicles

questions.comment: To regulate the movement of trams, as well as other route vehicles moving along the lane allocated for them, single-color traffic lights with four round white-moon colored signals located in the shape of the letter “T” can be used. (Clause 6.8 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you required to turn on your turn signals in this situation?

answers.text: Obligated only if there are other vehicles at the intersection

questions.comment: According to sign 4.1.2 “Move to the right”, you can continue driving only by turning right. Before turning, you must give the appropriate warning signal. (“Road signs”, paragraph 8.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.comment: There is a narrowing of the road ahead, which sign 1.20.2 “Narrowing of the road” warns drivers about. The truck driver needs to change lanes to the left. questions.question: The driver accidentally drove through the intersection. Is he allowed to use reverse in this situation and then continue moving to the left?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with other road users

questions.comment: Reversing at intersections is prohibited. (Clause 8.12 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Which cars and in what cases are allowed to drive outside populated areas at a speed of no more than 90 km/h?

answers.text: Passenger cars when towing a trailer on highways
Passenger cars and trucks with a permissible maximum weight of not more than 3.5 tons on all roads except motorways
All listed vehicles in specified cases

questions.comment: Outside populated areas, trucks with a r.m.m of no more than 3.5 tons and cars are allowed to travel at a speed of no more than 90 km/h on all roads except the highway, which is faster. A passenger car towing a trailer outside populated areas is allowed to drive on a highway at a speed of no more than 90 km/h (Clause 10.3 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Can you overtake?

answers.text: Yes, if the speed of the truck is less than 30 km/h

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited as visibility is limited. Sometimes there is a natural desire to overtake a “barely dragging” vehicle. Do not give in to such impulses recklessly. Remember! The most dangerous are overtaking at a significantly lower speed of the overtaken vehicle compared to the speed of the oncoming vehicle. (Clause 11.4 of the traffic regulations) The main condition for overtaking is “The distance required for overtaking should never exceed half the visible distance of the path.” That is, if your overtaking path is 200 m, then the visibility of the road should be at least 400 m. Strictly adhere to this rule, otherwise you will find yourself in a situation - a “trap” from which there is no way out.

questions.question: Is stopping at this place allowed?

answers.text: Allowed if the distance between the vehicle and the continuous marking line is at least 3 m

questions.comment: Stopping at pedestrian crossings and at a distance closer than 5 m is prohibited. This distance is not maintained. You cannot stop at the designated place. (Clause 12.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: The meanings of which road signs are canceled by traffic lights?
questions.comment: Traffic is regulated by: traffic controllers, traffic signals, priority signs, markings, road surfaces, and the “right-hand rule.” According to the above-mentioned “principle of priority for traffic regulation,” priority signs work (i.e., we are guided by them) in the case when there is no traffic controller, the traffic light is turned off, faulty, or switched to “yellow flashing mode.” (“Road Signs”, paragraphs 6.15 and 13.3 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: When turning right you must give way to:

questions.question: You intend to turn left. Who do you have to give way to?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. Vehicles on the main road have priority. They are guided by the “right hand rule” among themselves. After they pass, following the same rule, vehicles on the secondary road will pass. The passenger car passes the intersection first, you are the second, the motorcyclist is the third, the bus is the last. (Clause 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Rules)

questions.question: What should you do in this situation?

answers.text: Drive through a railway crossing without stopping at the sign
Stop in front of the sign and continue driving immediately after the train passes
Stop in front of the sign and continue driving, making sure there is no approaching train

questions.comment: There is a multi-track railway on the route. You need to stop in front of sign 2.5 “Non-stop traffic is prohibited”, wait for the train to pass and, after making sure that there are no approaching trains from both directions, continue further movement. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 15.1, 15.2, 15.3, 15.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: To attract the attention of the driver of an overtaken vehicle when driving in a populated area during daylight hours, you can:

answers.text: Only by briefly switching the headlights from low beam to high beam
Only by combined sound and light signals

questions.comment: The use of a sound signal when overtaking is allowed only outside populated areas. In a populated area, to warn about overtaking, instead of a sound signal, a light signal may be given, which is a short-term switching of headlights from low beam to high beam. (Clause 19.11 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: In what cases is it prohibited to operate a vehicle?

The ignition timing adjustment is broken
The audible warning device is faulty

topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: How does the braking distance of a vehicle depend on its speed?

answers.text: Increases with the square of the speed

questions.comment: The braking distance depends on the square of the speed. So, when the speed doubles, the braking distance will increase four times, and when the speed increases three times, the braking distance will increase nine times. (“Driving technology”)

questions.question: How to stop bleeding when a vein and small arteries are injured?

answers.text: Apply a pressure bandage to the wound site
Apply a tourniquet above the wound site
Apply a tourniquet below the wound site

questions.comment: It is necessary to apply a pressure bandage directly to the wound. (“Medical assistance in case of an accident”)

questions.question: Leaving the yard or other adjacent territory:

answers.text: Considered a crossroads of equal roads
Considered a crossroads of unequal roads

questions.comment: “Adjacent territory” is the territory directly adjacent to the road and not intended for through traffic of vehicles (yards, residential areas, parking lots, gas stations, enterprises, etc.). Exiting from the yard or from other adjacent territory is not considered an intersection. (Clause 1.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Which of the following signs require a mandatory stop?
questions.comment: Only sign “B” - 2.5 “Moving without stopping is prohibited” - requires a mandatory stop. The sign is installed either at the intersection of roadways (case 1) or at the railway station. crossing, or quarantine post (case 2). Sign “A” - 2.6 “Right of way for oncoming traffic” - prohibits entry onto a narrow section of the road if this may impede oncoming traffic. Sign “B” - 6.16 “Stop line” - indicates the place where vehicles stop when there is a prohibiting traffic light at intersections or prohibition of passage through a railway crossing. Sign “D” - 2.4 “Give way” - determines the order of passage of a specific intersection. If necessary, choose a stopping place yourself, guided by the rule: “You must not resume or continue driving, or perform any maneuver if the action of your car forces other road users to change direction or speed.” (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: In the area covered by this sign, it is permitted to use a sound signal:

answers.text: Only to prevent a traffic accident
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: In the area covered by sign 3.26 “Sound Signal Prohibited,” sound signaling is prohibited, except in cases of warning of a traffic accident. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Where do the requirements of the Rules relating to populated areas begin to apply?

answers.text: Only from the place where the “Beginning of a settlement” road sign was installed on a white background
From the installation site of a road sign with the name of the settlement on a white or blue background
At the beginning of the built-up area immediately adjacent to the road

questions.comment: Only from the place of installation of sign 5.23.1 or 5.23.2 “Beginning of a populated area” on a white background. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: This vertical marking marks the side surfaces of the fences:

answers.text: Only on dangerous sections of roads
Only on sections of roads that are not considered dangerous

questions.comment: Vertical markings 2.6 indicate the side surfaces of fences in all cases when markings 2.5 are not used, used on curved roads, steep slopes, and other dangerous areas.

questions.question: What do a red flashing signal or two alternately flashing red lights mean at a railway crossing?

answers.text: Movement is permitted with extreme caution

questions.comment: A red flashing signal or two alternately flashing red signals prohibit movement. Flashing red signals are used at railway crossings, in front of drawbridges, ferries or crossings and in places where firefighters and other emergency vehicles leave. (Clause 6.2 of the Traffic Regulations. Commentary on the Traffic Regulations of the Russian Federation, publishing house "Za Rulem")
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What light signals are you required to give in this situation?

answers.text: Turn on the left turn indicator lights
Briefly switch the headlights from low to high beam
Apply the listed light signals at the same time

questions.question: In what directions can you continue driving in the second lane?
questions.comment: Sign 4.1.6 “Moving right or left” from the leftmost lane allows you to turn left and turn around to move in the opposite direction. To turn right, it was necessary to change lanes to the far right lane in advance. (“Road signs”, clause 8.5 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn in this place?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with the movement of route vehicles

questions.comment: Turning around at stops for route vehicles is prohibited. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is overtaking allowed at intersections?

answers.text: Permitted only when driving on the main road at uncontrolled intersections

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited at signalized intersections, as well as at uncontrolled intersections when driving on a road that is not the main one. (Clause 11.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which car drivers violated the stopping rules?
questions.comment: Stopping and parking of vehicles if there is a shoulder should be carried out on it (as the driver of car “A” did). And only in its absence - at the edge of the roadway. Drivers of cars “B” and “C” are violators of traffic rules. (Clause 12.1 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to turn left. What are your actions?

answers.text: Stop in front of the intersection, wait for the green traffic light on the median, and begin the maneuver
Having arrived at the intersection, stop at the stop line and, after waiting for the green signal of the traffic light installed on the dividing strip, complete the maneuver
Perform a maneuver without stopping at an intersection

questions.comment: In a normal situation, the driver leaves the intersection regardless of the traffic light signals at the exit from the intersection. But here the situation is different. Separate traffic lights are used. There are two intersections of roadways at the intersection. When turning left, you are required to stop at the stop line (marking 1.12) when the traffic light is prohibiting. After turning on the permitting signal, continue driving through the intersection. (Clause 13.7 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who should you give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Regardless of its configuration, drivers are guided by the “right-hand rule.” The truck passes first, since there is no obstacle on the right, the passenger car is second, and you are the last. You should give way to both vehicles. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: When driving straight, you must give way:
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Vehicles located on the main road have priority. After they pass, vehicles on the secondary road pass, which are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. There is an obstacle on the right side of the motorcyclist, he is giving way to you. Vehicles will pass the intersection in the following order: bus, car, you, motorcyclist. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 13.9, 13.10 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Where should you stop if there is a traffic jam just beyond the pedestrian crossing?

answers.text: At a pedestrian crossing, if there are no pedestrians
No closer than 5 m to the pedestrian crossing

questions.comment: Here you are making a temporary cessation of movement, and not a deliberate stop. Therefore, you stop before the border of the pedestrian crossing, which is indicated by signs or markings. The correct answer is immediately before the pedestrian crossing. (Clause 14.4 of the traffic rules)
topic: Pedestrian crossings and stops of fixed-route vehicles

answers.text: The engine does not develop maximum power
The engine is unstable at idle
Power supply and exhaust systems are incomplete and leaky

questions.comment: In the event of a malfunction of the engine power supply and exhaust gas systems and their incompleteness and leaks, the operation of the vehicle is prohibited (“List of faults”, paragraph 8.2).
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: Reducing the braking distance of a vehicle not equipped with an anti-lock braking system is achieved by:

answers.text: By pressing the brake pedal all the way
By intermittently pressing the brake pedal
By pressing the brake pedal while simultaneously using the parking brake system

questions.comment: Wheel locking when braking on a wet, slippery surface causes “skidding” - uncontrollability of the car. Therefore, to reduce the braking distance and ensure traffic safety, use pulsed, intermittent pressure on the brake pedal and alternately release it.

questions.question: The minimum required distance when driving on a dry road in a passenger car is considered to be the distance that the car will cover in no less than:
questions.comment: Recommendations on this issue vary. The simplest recommendation for drivers of passenger cars is to maintain a distance equal to at least half the speed of travel (approximately this distance is equal to the distance of the car in 2 seconds). It should be taken into account that during heavy traffic and at a greater distance, frequent “wedges” of other vehicles will occur. This will “stress” you. The most important thing is to understand what kind of “leader” you have ahead of you, what his behavior is. What is your braking distance? There may be a circumstance that can increase it compared to the usual one to which you are accustomed. Taking the right steps will help you avoid a “collision.”

questions.question: If, as a result of a road traffic accident (RTA), damage was caused only to property, then, having previously recorded the position of vehicles in relation to each other and road infrastructure objects, traces and objects related to the accident, damage to vehicles, the driver involved in the accident:

Has the right to vacate the roadway at his own discretion

questions.question: In this situation, stop:

answers.text: Permitted only to route vehicles and vehicles used as passenger taxis
Permitted only to vehicles driven by a disabled person or transporting disabled people, including disabled children

questions.comment: Route vehicles and vehicles used as passenger taxis may deviate from the effect of sign 3.27 “Stopping is prohibited,” but only in places where route vehicles stop or where vehicles used as passenger taxis are parked, indicated by markings 1.17.1 and (or) signs 5.16, 5.18, respectively. This road situation does not meet the stated requirements, therefore stopping the vehicle in the area covered by sign 3.27 is prohibited (“Road Signs”).

questions.question: By driving which car can you get ahead in this situation?

answers.text: Cars or trucks with a permissible maximum weight of not more than 2.5 tons
Cars or trucks with a permissible maximum weight of no more than 3.5 tons

questions.question: What does this markup mean:

answers.text: Recommended speed for this section of the road
Permitted maximum speed on this section of the road

questions.comment: Marking 1.24.2 duplicates sign 3.24 “Maximum speed limit” and is used in conjunction with it. (“Horizontal markings”, “Road signs”)

questions.question: What should road users follow if the traffic controller’s instructions contradict the meanings of traffic lights and the requirements of road signs?
questions.comment: The traffic controller's signals take precedence over traffic light signals, the requirements of road signs or markings 6.15. In such situations, when a traffic controller prescribes a movement pattern for drivers and pedestrians that is different from that provided for by the existing traffic organization, he, as a rule, gives additional gestures or signals to explain the changes. So, you must follow the instructions of the traffic controller, even if they contradict the traffic lights and the requirements of road signs.
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

answers.text: Must give way to a car moving in the adjacent lane
You have an advantage in movement

questions.question: On what trajectory are you allowed to make a U-turn?

answers.text: U-turn is prohibited along the specified trajectories

questions.comment: The effect of sign 4.1.1 “Move straight”, installed before the intersection of roadways, extends to the first intersection behind the sign. answers.text: Pass a truck on the right side of the road
Continue driving only after the truck has cleared the lane.

questions.comment: A truck driver gives a turn signal. Passing on the right in this situation is allowed if you make a detour without going onto the side of the road, on which traffic is prohibited. In this situation, wait until the truck clears the lane. (Section 9.9 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: Is overtaking on a hill prohibited?

answers.text: Prohibited only at the end of the climb

questions.comment: The end of the rise is the point where the longitudinal profile of the road breaks. There is no visibility when approaching this place. Therefore, the Rules prohibit overtaking at the end of a climb, on dangerous turns and in other areas with limited visibility. (Clause 11.4 of the Traffic Regulations) Do not forget the main condition for overtaking - “The path required for overtaking should never exceed half of the visible segment of the path.”

questions.comment: The distance between both stopped vehicles and the continuous marking line is less than 3 m, which is not allowed. Therefore, stopping is prohibited. (Clause 12.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do when driving through a roundabout?

answers.text: Act by mutual agreement with the truck driver

questions.comment: At the entrance on the road, which is not the main one, to the intersection at which the circular traffic is organized and which is indicated by the sign 4.3, the driver of the vehicle is obliged to give way to vehicles moving along such an intersection. questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when turning left?

questions.question: When towing on a flexible coupling, a distance must be provided between the towing and towed vehicles:
questions.comment: When towing on a flexible hitch, the distance between the towing and towed vehicles must be within 4 – 6 m.(Clause 20.3 of the SDA)

questions.question: What administrative offenses committed by a driver who is deprived of the right to drive vehicles entail administrative arrest?

answers.text: Driving; Leaving by the driver, in violation of the Rules, the scene of a traffic accident in which he was a participant
Driving while intoxicated; failure to comply with the legal requirement of an authorized official to undergo a medical examination for intoxication

questions.comment: Administrative arrest of drivers for all of the listed actions is provided for by the articles of the Code of Administrative Offenses: Art. 12.7, Part 2; Art. 12.26 p.2; Art. 12.27. Part 2.

questions.question: Eliminating rear axle skidding by increasing speed is possible:

answers.text: Only on front wheel drive vehicle
Only on rear wheel drive car
On any of the listed vehicles

questions.comment: A front-wheel drive car differs not only in its layout, but also in its behavior on the road. When driving in a straight line, it does not experience the slightest tendency to skid. Skidding occurs when cornering due to centrifugal forces. If the driver of a rear-wheel drive car in this situation reduces the speed and turns the steering wheel in the direction of the skid, then the driver of a front-wheel drive car should under no circumstances do this. If the gas is released, engine braking occurs, then, due to inertial forces, it “pivots” forward, which unloads the rear wheels, and on the contrary, in order to restore traction with the road, they just need the additional load that occurs when the speed increases.

questions.question: Which picture shows the correct position of your hands on the steering wheel?
