questions.question: What does the combination of red and yellow traffic lights mean?

answers.text: Soon the green signal will turn on
The red light will be on soon

questions.comment: The combination of red and yellow traffic lights prohibits movement and informs about the upcoming turning on of the green signal. (Clause 6.2 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: At what distance from the vehicle should a warning triangle be placed in this situation?
questions.comment: The action takes place outside a populated area, so the distance at which a warning triangle is installed is greater than in a populated area. Install the sign according to the situation, but this distance must be at least 30 m. (Clause 7.2 of the traffic rules)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: Who should you give way to when turning into the yard?
questions.comment: When turning left outside an intersection, the driver of a trackless vehicle is obliged to give way to oncoming vehicles, persons using a SIM card for movement, and pedestrians whose movement path he crosses. (Clause 8.3, 8.8 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: To ensure safety when reversing from a parking space with limited visibility, you must:
questions.comment: Reversing a vehicle is permitted provided that this maneuver is safe and does not interfere with other road users. If necessary, the driver must resort to the help of other persons. (Clause 8.12 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: At what maximum speed do you have the right to continue driving a truck with a permissible maximum weight of not more than 3.5 tons after entering the road adjacent to the left?
questions.comment: On all roads of a populated area, marked with sign 5.23.1 with a white background, driving at a speed of no more than 60 km/h is permitted (“Road signs”, clause 10.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do in this situation?

answers.text: Give way to an oncoming car
Act by mutual agreement with the driver of the oncoming car

questions.comment: If oncoming traffic is difficult to pass, the driver on whose side there is an obstacle must give way. In this situation, the advantage is yours - you pass first. (Clause 11.7 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: The drivers of which cars did not violate the stopping rules?
questions.comment: The action takes place in a populated area on a road marked with sign 5.5 “One-way road.” On such a road, a passenger car is allowed to stop and park on the left side of the road in the direction of travel (place “A”). You cannot stop and stand at place “B”, since you will be in the coverage area of ​​sign 3.27 “Stopping is prohibited” with sign 8.2.3 “Validity area”, which indicates the end of the coverage area of ​​this sign. You can park your car in place “A” or “B”. (“Road signs”, paragraph 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You need to give way to other road users:

answers.text: Only when turning left or making a U-turn
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: When turning right, you must give way to pedestrians. When turning left or making a U-turn, the tram, which has priority in equal conditions, goes to the tram. There are no obstacles when driving straight. The correct answer is in both of the listed cases. (Clause 6.2, 13.1, 13.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to continue straight ahead. What are your actions?

answers.text: Give way to a truck as it approaches from the right
Give way to the truck as it is on the main road

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. You have an obstacle on the right, the truck has the right of way. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when turning left?

answers.text: A car with a flashing light and a special sound signal turned on

questions.comment: Undoubtedly, an “operative” with a blue flashing light and a siren has an advantage. Everyone else is obliged to ensure his unhindered passage through the intersection. After passing it, you pass, since you are on the main road and have priority over a truck located on a secondary road. (Clause 3.1, 13.9 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: When forced to stop at a railway crossing, if there are passengers in the vehicle, the driver must:

answers.text: Drop people off if the measures taken do not allow the vehicle to be removed from the crossing
Disembark people when a train appears

questions.comment: If forced to stop at a crossing, the driver must immediately unload people and take measures to clear the crossing. (Clause 15.5 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When stopping and parking on unlit sections of roads in the dark, you must:
questions.comment: When stopping and parking at night on unlit sections of roads, as well as in conditions of insufficient visibility, the side lights on the vehicle must be turned on. (Clause 19.3 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: In what cases is it permissible to operate a car?

answers.text: The windshield wipers provided by the vehicle manufacturer are faulty or missing
The windshield washers provided by the vehicle manufacturer are faulty or missing

questions.comment: The “List of Faults” prohibits the use of windshield wipers and windshield washers if the specified malfunctions occur. The serviceability of the window lifter is not covered by this list, which means operation is permitted. (“List of faults”, paragraph 4.5)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: What trajectory does a passenger car trailer follow when cornering?

answers.text: Farther from the center of the turn than the vehicle's path
On the trajectory of the car
Closer to the center of the turn than the vehicle's path

questions.comment: Any trailer, including a car trailer, moves closer to the center of the turn than the car's trajectory.

questions.question: It is generally accepted that the average driver reaction time is:
questions.comment: The reaction time for each driver is different and is not a constant value. It has been experimentally determined that the average reaction time of drivers is approximately 1 second. What is a second - say the combination of words “twenty-two”. The time of the second has passed. If the individual reaction time increases, it should be compensated by reducing the average speed of the vehicle. More details about the driver’s reaction, “lost time,” the minimum safe distance, and overtaking are described in the manual “Driving School of the Russian Federation,” published by EKSMO publishing house.

questions.question: The main point at the crossroads is:

answers.text: Road with asphalt concrete surface in relation to the road covered with paving stones
A road with three or more lanes relative to a road with two lanes

questions.comment: In the absence of signs indicating the main road, the paved road in relation to the dirt road is the main one. (Clause 1.2, the term “Main Road”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to enter the bridge at the same time as the motorcycle driver?

answers.text: It is allowed if you do not impede his movement

questions.comment: This sign (2.6) prohibits entering a narrow section of the road only if it would impede oncoming traffic. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Which car drivers violated parking rules?
questions.comment: The effect of sign 3.27 “Stopping is prohibited” extends to the nearest intersection. In this case, to the intersection with the road adjacent to the left. You can park the car in place “B”. Only the driver of car “A” violates the rules of stopping and parking. (“Road signs”, clause 12.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Which of the indicated plates extend the effect of the signs installed with them to trucks with a permissible maximum weight of not more than 3.5 tons?
questions.comment: Plates 8.4.1 (A) and 8.4.3 (B) “Type of vehicle” apply to: “A” – to trucks, including those with a trailer, with r.m.m. more than 3.5 tons, “B” - for cars, as well as trucks with r.m.m. up to 3.5 tons. Plate 8.6.1 (B) “Method of parking a vehicle” extends the effect of sign 6.4 “Parking (parking space)” to ALL vehicles. Therefore, only plates “B” and “C” apply to trucks, r.m.m. of which no more than 3.5 tons (“Road signs”)

questions.question: The right lane is designed to move:

answers.text: Buses and trolleybuses, which are route vehicles, school buses and passenger taxis, as well as cyclists

questions.comment: On the rightmost lane indicated by marking 1.23.1 (in the form of the letter "A") and sign 5.14.1 "Lane for fixed-route vehicles" of the vehicles listed in the responses, buses and trolleybuses moving along the established routes with designated stopping places related to fixed-route vehicles, as well as school buses, passenger taxis and cyclists have the right to move.(Clause 1.2 of traffic rules, "Road signs", "Horizontal marking")

questions.question: What should a passenger car driver do when an emergency service vehicle approaches?

answers.text: Change over to the right lane
Stop on the right side of the sidewalk

questions.comment: Emergency service vehicles driving with a blue flashing light and a special sound signal on should give way, ensuring unobstructed passage. The driver of a passenger car should change lanes to the right lane and continue driving. (Clause 3.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: The driver's arm bent at the elbow is a signal informing you of his intention:

answers.text: Stop to give way to a motorcycle

questions.comment: The signal for a right turn corresponds to the right hand extended to the side or the left hand extended to the side and bent at the elbow at a right angle upward (as in this situation). (Clause 8.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You can continue driving when turning left:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: When turning left at an intersection, you can choose any direction of movement. The main condition is that when leaving the intersection of roadways, your vehicle should not end up on the side of oncoming traffic. (Clause 8.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: If the trajectories of vehicles intersect, and the order of passage is not specified by the Rules, you should:

answers.text: Give way to vehicles approaching from the right
Give way to vehicles approaching from the left
Act according to the mutual agreement of the drivers

questions.comment: In cases not specified by the Rules, and this is, for example, in the areas of parking lots, gas stations, factories, in fields, meadows, etc., the order of passage is determined by the “right-hand rule,” i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right gives way. (Clause 8.9 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: In what cases, on roads whose roadways are divided by marking lines, are drivers required to drive strictly along the lanes?

answers.text: Only if lanes are marked with solid lines

questions.comment: If there are markings, traffic is carried out strictly along the designated lanes in all cases. (Clause 9.7 of the traffic rules)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken:

answers.text: Has the right to act at his own discretion

questions.comment: The driver of an overtaken vehicle is prohibited from preventing overtaking by increasing the speed or other actions. (Clause 11.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop to disembark passengers at the specified location?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with the movement of route vehicles

questions.comment: In populated areas on roads with one lane in each direction, without tram tracks in the middle, stopping and parking is allowed not only on the right side, but also on the left in the direction of travel. Stopping to disembark and pick up passengers is permitted at stopping places for route vehicles, marked with zigzag markings 1.17.1, if this stop does not interfere with their movement. (“Road signs”, paragraphs 12.1, 12.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to turn right. What are your actions?

answers.text: Wait for another signal from the traffic controller
Give way to a car making a U-turn

questions.comment: From the side of the traffic controller's outstretched right hand, trackless vehicles are only allowed to move to the right. In this case, the turning car, guided by the “right-hand rule,” gives way to you. (Clause 6.10 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: In what case should you miss the tram?

answers.text: When turning left, changing lanes onto tram tracks in the same direction
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: You and the tram are on the same road under equal conditions. In this case, the tram always has an advantage over trackless vehicles. You must give way to the tram in both of these cases. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is unregulated and unequal. Vehicles located on the main road have priority, which are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves. Afterwards, vehicles on the secondary road pass the intersection. The truck passes first, you give way to it. The last one to pass will be a passenger car. (Clause 13.3, 13.9, 13.12 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You are required to give way to a truck:

answers.text: In both of the above cases

questions.comment: You are leaving a residential area, as indicated by sign 5.22 “End of a residential area.” Give way to other road users, in this situation - to a truck in both of the above cases. (“Road signs”, clause 17.3 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: When is it necessary to turn on low beam headlights or daytime running lights during daylight hours?

answers.text: Only when driving outside the populated area
Only when driving in a populated area
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: Low beam headlights or daytime running lights during daylight hours must be turned on in both of these cases. (Clause 19.5 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of external lighting fixtures and audible signals

questions.question: Administrative liability is established for violation of traffic rules or vehicle operating rules, resulting in the following:

answers.text: Minor harm to human health or minor material damage
Mild or moderate harm to human health
Light or moderate harm to human health or material damage

questions.comment: In accordance with Art. 12.24 of the Code of Administrative Offenses, administrative liability is established for violations of traffic rules or vehicle operating rules that resulted in minor or moderate harm to human health. "Code of the Russian Federation on Administrative Offenses"

questions.question: How to properly perform emergency braking on a slippery road if the car is not equipped with an anti-lock braking system?

answers.text: Press the brake pedal all the way and hold it until it comes to a complete stop.
Press the brake pedal while applying the parking brake
Brake by intermittently pressing the brake pedal, avoiding wheel locking.

questions.comment: Emergency, non-service, braking on a slippery surface should be done in combination, i.e. by “engine braking” (without disengaging the clutch until the speed drops significantly) and intermittently pressing the brake pedal, avoiding complete blocking of the wheels, which will result in “skidding” and an increase in braking distance. The main mistake in this case is holding the pedal for a long time, that is, the inability to brake impulsively (intermittently).

questions.question: How does a driver perceive the speed of his car when driving for a long time on a flat road at high speed?

answers.text: Seems smaller than it really is
Perception of speed does not change
Seems bigger than it really is

questions.comment: The driver determines the speed of movement by the speed of movement of objects falling into his field of vision. During long monotonous movement, the speed seems less than in reality. To control your speed in such situations, use the speedometer more often than usual.

questions.question: Category “B” includes cars:

answers.text: With a permissible maximum weight of no more than 2.5 tons and the number of seats, in addition to the driver's seat, no more than 8
With a permissible maximum weight of no more than 3.5 tons and the number of seats, in addition to the driver's seat, no more than 8
With a permissible maximum weight of no more than 3.5 tons and the number of seats, in addition to the driver's seat, no more than 16

questions.comment: In accordance with Art. 25 clause 1 of the Federal Law “On Road Safety”, category “B” includes cars with a permissible maximum weight of no more than 3.5 tons and the number of seats, in addition to the driver’s seat, no more than 8.

questions.question: Which of the following signs are installed immediately before a railway crossing?
questions.comment: Of those marked, only sign “B” - 1.3.2 “Multi-track railway” - is installed immediately before the railway crossing. It should be taken into account that in the absence of barriers on the railway. When crossing, signs 1.3.1 and 1.3.2 determine the size of the crossing. Combinations of signs “A” and “B” are installed outside populated areas at a distance of 150-300 m (“Road signs”)

questions.question: You are allowed to make a U-turn:

answers.text: Along any trajectory of the specified

questions.comment: Traffic at the intersection marked with sign 4.3 “Roundabout” is organized in a circle in the direction of the arrows. Trajectory “A” passes in the opposite direction, which is unacceptable. To make a U-turn, you should go to the intersection and take a “lap of honor.” A U-turn can only be made along trajectory “B”. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Can you park your car behind the overpass?

answers.text: No closer than 5 m from the overpass support

questions.comment: In the indicated location, parking is prohibited with sign 3.28 “Parking prohibited,” which extends to the nearest intersection. The overpass cannot terminate the validity of this sign. (“Road Signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to change lanes with reversible traffic in this situation?

answers.text: Permitted only for left turns or U-turns

questions.comment: The green arrow of a reversible traffic light allows movement in the reversible lane. You can cross the double broken line marking 1.9 to follow it, i.e. in the same direction. (Clause 6.7 of the Traffic Regulations, “Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: You are allowed to move:

answers.text: In any of the directions indicated

questions.comment: The traffic controller’s actions apply to the intersection of roadways at which he is located. We will assume that it is at the first intersection. From the arm's length side, trackless vehicles are only allowed to move to the right. You can continue moving along the trajectory “A”. (Clause 6.10 of the traffic rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What turn signals are you required to turn on when making a U-turn along such a trajectory?

answers.text: First turn right, and when moving from the sidewalk - turn left

questions.comment: If, when turning outside an intersection, the width of the roadway is not sufficient to perform the maneuver from the extreme position (in accordance with paragraph 8.5), it is allowed to be made from the right edge of the roadway (but not from the middle of the roadway in this direction). A U-turn along this trajectory is made on a narrow road. During its execution, it is necessary to exercise great caution and do not perform it at high speed, since the driver driving behind may, when the right turn signal is turned on at the initial moment, think that you are making a stop. After turning on the left indicator, make sure once again that there is no obstacle, since during a turn you must give way to both passing and oncoming vehicles. (Clause 8.1, 8.5, 8.8 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: A situation in which the driver of a vehicle moving in the right lane is required to give way when changing lanes is shown:
questions.comment: When changing lanes at the same time, drivers are guided by the “right-hand rule.” This is the situation in the right picture. A car moving in the right lane has priority. In the left picture there is a single rebuild. When changing lanes, you give way to vehicles moving in the same direction without changing direction. The “owner of the lane” has an advantage in such a situation. The correct answer is in the left figure. (Clause 8.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Is the driver of a car allowed to drive in reverse to pick up a passenger?

answers.text: Permitted if it does not interfere with route vehicles

questions.comment: Reversing in areas where route vehicles stop is prohibited. (Clause 8.11, 8.12 of the Traffic Regulations).

questions.question: In this situation, in order to continue driving in a forward direction, you have the right:

answers.text: Pass the truck on the right
Continue driving only after the truck makes a left turn
Perform any of the following actions

questions.comment: In this situation, you have the right to choose: either pass a truck on the right; or wait until the lane you are on is cleared in order to continue moving without unnecessary lane changes. (Traffic rules: 1.2 terms “Changing Lanes”, Advancing”, 8.4)

questions.question: Is it prohibited to overtake on bridges, overpasses, overpasses and under them?

answers.text: Prohibited only under bridges, overpasses and overpasses
Prohibited only if there is a continuous marking line

questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited - on bridges, overpasses, overpasses and under them. (Clause 11.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Can you stop in the tunnel to pick up a passenger?

answers.text: Yes, if you drive a taxi

questions.comment: Definitely not. Since stopping in tunnels, under overpasses, bridges, overpasses is prohibited. (Clause 12.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do when turning right?

answers.text: Stop before the stop line and let pedestrians pass and turn right
When arriving at an intersection, stop in front of the pedestrian crossing to let pedestrians pass.
Continue driving without stopping at the intersection

questions.comment: When turning right or left at any intersection (controlled, unregulated), the driver is obliged to give way to pedestrians crossing the roadway onto which he is turning. (Clause 6.2, 13.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When moving in which direction will you have an advantage?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”. You have no interference on the right, in any of the directions listed. Pass the intersection first. (Clause 13.11 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to continue straight ahead. Your actions:
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. You and the tram are on the main road. The “right hand rule” does not work in this case. Under equal conditions, a tram has an advantage over trackless vehicles. Give way to the tram. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations, “Road signs”)

questions.question: On which sections of the highway is it prohibited to drive in reverse?

answers.text: Only at entry or exit points
Only in places where route vehicles stop

questions.comment: Reversing on the highway is prohibited along the entire length of the road. (Clause 16.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: On which roads are moped drivers prohibited from turning left or turning around?

answers.text: On roads with more than one lane for traffic in a given direction

questions.comment: Moped drivers can move along the right edge of the roadway in one row. They are prohibited from turning left or making a U-turn on roads with tram tracks or on roads with more than one lane for traffic in a given direction. (Clause 24.7, 24.8 of traffic rules)
topic: Training riding and additional requirements for the movement of cyclists

questions.question: What malfunction prevents the vehicle from driving during rain or snow?

answers.text: Windshield wipers do not work as intended
Driver's side windshield wiper does not work

questions.comment: It is prohibited to drive with the windshield wiper inoperative on the driver's side during rain or snowfall. (Clause 2.3.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: With increasing speed when turning, the magnitude of the centrifugal force is:

answers.text: Increases with the square of the speed

questions.comment: Centrifugal force depends on the mass of the car, the turning radius and is proportional to the square of the speed. The driver cannot influence the weight of a moving vehicle. It can increase the turning radius somewhat, but the speed, which is the most effective value, for this force completely depends on the driver. Therefore, before entering a turn, it is recommended to reduce the speed. (“Driving techniques”)

questions.question: How is first aid provided for broken limbs if there are no transport tires and available means for their manufacture?

answers.text: The upper limb, extended along the body, is bandaged to the body. The lower limbs are bandaged to each other, with soft fabric placed between them.
The upper limb, bent at the elbow, is suspended on a scarf and bandaged to the body. The lower limbs are bandaged to each other, making sure to place soft fabric between them.
The upper limb, bent at the elbow, is suspended on a scarf and bandaged to the body. The lower limbs are pressed tightly against each other and bandaged.

questions.comment: In such a situation, the upper limb, bent at the elbow, is suspended on a scarf and bandaged to the body. The lower limbs are bandaged to each other, be sure to lay soft cloth between them. A special feature of the action is to be sure to lay soft cloth between the limbs.

questions.question: How many roadways does this intersection have?
questions.comment: This intersection has two intersections of roadways, which are formed by a dividing strip. (Clause 1.2 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: These signs warn of the approach:

answers.text: To the place of work on the road
Towards a railway crossing with a barrier
To a railway crossing without a barrier

questions.comment: Sign 1.1 “Railway crossing with a barrier” and sign 1.4.1 “Approaching a railway crossing” are located on the same post, since outside the populated area they are located at a distance of 150 - 300 m from the dangerous area. Outside the populated area, sign 1.1 must be repeated. These signs warn of approaching a railway crossing with barriers. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which of these signs does not apply to vehicles driven by disabled people of groups I and II, transporting such disabled people or disabled children, if the identification sign “Disabled” is installed on the vehicles?
questions.comment: Of these signs, the effect does not apply to vehicles driven by disabled people of groups I and II, transporting such disabled people or disabled children, if the identification sign “Disabled” is installed on the vehicle: sign “B” - 3.2 “Movement prohibited” and sign “D” - 3.28 “Parking prohibited.” (“Road signs”)

questions.question: You can continue driving in the leftmost lane:
questions.comment: Signs indicating the direction of movement along lanes (lanes) that permit a left turn from the leftmost lane also permit a U-turn. When moving in the leftmost lane, according to sign 5.15.2 “Lane directions”, you can turn left or turn around to continue moving in the opposite direction. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop at this place?

answers.text: Allowed only with entry onto the sidewalk
Permitted if it does not interfere with route vehicles

questions.comment: The intermittent yellow line 1.10 indicates places where parking is prohibited. From March 1, 2023, it is applied only independently. There is nothing contradicting the stop, i.e. it is allowed. (“Horizontal Layout”)

questions.question: The driver of the car has an advantage over other road users:

answers.text: Only with blue or white-lunar flashing light turned on
Only with orange or yellow flashing light turned on
Only with a blue flashing light (blue and red) and a special sound signal turned on

questions.comment: To gain an advantage, an “operational” vehicle must use a combination of a blue or blue and red flashing light and a special sound signal. (Clause 3.1 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to stop just beyond the intersection. At what point should the right turn indicators be turned on?

answers.text: Before entering the intersection, to warn other drivers about the stop in advance
The location where the turn signals are turned on does not matter, since right turns are prohibited

questions.comment: Here the answer should be supplemented with clarification. Each driver is guided in his actions only by those signs that are located on his road. In the situation depicted, the driver of the car knows about your advantage. You judge this by his actions. You are convinced that he is giving way. Turning on the turn signal before the intersection will be clearly perceived by him: that you intend to make a right turn. Turning on immediately after entering an intersection may also be interpreted incorrectly. For example, that you are somewhat delayed in making a decision on the direction of further movement, but will still make a right turn. Therefore, turn on the turn signal at the intersection, but not in the initial phase of entering the intersection. Then a mandatory condition will be met - the signal will not mislead other road users. (Clause 8.2 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When leaving the road into the adjacent territory on the right, you:

answers.text: Take advantage of other road users
Must give way only to pedestrians
Must give way only to cyclists
Must give way to pedestrians and cyclists

questions.comment: When leaving the road into the adjacent territory, you give way to cyclists and pedestrians, persons using SIM cards for movement, whose movement path you are crossing. (Clause 8.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn when driving on an incline?

answers.text: Allowed only when road visibility is 100 m or more

questions.comment: A broken road limits visibility. A U-turn is prohibited in places where visibility of the road in at least one direction is less than 100 m. (Clause 8.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What is the maximum speed allowed to continue driving when towing a disabled motor vehicle?
questions.comment: When towing, the speed should not exceed 50 km/h, which is the maximum.(Clause 10.4 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Can you start overtaking?

answers.text: Yes, if overtaking is completed before the intersection

questions.comment: Table 8.1.1 “Distance to object” under sign 2.4 “Give way” indicates the distance from the sign to the intersection of unequal roads on which overtaking is permitted in the direction of the main road. You are on a secondary road, so overtaking that has begun must be completed before the intersection. (“Road signs”, clause 11.4 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Which car drivers violated the stopping rules?
questions.comment: Since the action takes place in a populated area on a section of the road marked with sign 5.5 “One-way road,” in this case you can stop on the left side in the direction of travel. In this situation, in place “B”, behind the pedestrian crossing. Immediately before the pedestrian crossing, in places “A” and “B”, you cannot stop. (Clause 12.1, 12.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: What should you do when turning left?

answers.text: Give way only to a car with a flashing light and a special sound signal on

questions.comment: The intersection is controlled. Priority signs don't work. The “operative” with special signals deviates from the requirements of traffic light signals. Other drivers are obliged to ensure his unhindered passage. When turning left, you are required to give way to a passenger car moving straight from the opposite direction. (Clause 3.1, 3.2, 13.3, 13.4 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: When driving in which direction are you required to give way to a tram?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. You and the tram are in equal conditions. In this case, the tram always has an advantage over trackless vehicles. (Clause 13.11 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to turn right. Can you start turning?

answers.text: You can after the truck starts making a left turn.

questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. Sign 2.4 obliges you to give way to vehicles moving along the road you are crossing. Only after making sure that the truck is actually turning left and your movement cannot interfere with it, drive out to the intersection to make a right turn. (Clause 1.2, 13.9 Traffic Regulations, “Road Signs”)

questions.question: Having approached the tram of the same direction, which stopped at the landing site, which is located in the middle of the road, the driver must:

answers.text: Give way to pedestrians walking to or from the tram
Stop and continue driving only after the tram doors are closed
Stop and continue moving only after the tram starts moving

questions.comment: If there is a landing area, give way to pedestrians walking to or from the tram. In the absence of pedestrians crossing the roadway from the side of the doors, taking the necessary precautions, i.e. the possibility of stopping you at any time when a “jumped out pedestrian” appears, you can continue driving without waiting for the doors to close and the route vehicle to start moving. (Clause 14.6 of the traffic rules. “Commentary to the traffic rules of the Russian Federation”, publishing house “Za Rulem”)
topic: Pedestrian crossings and stops of fixed-route vehicles

questions.question: It is prohibited to transport children in a car without the use of appropriate child restraint systems (devices):

answers.text: If they are transported under 7 years of age
If they are transported between the ages of 7 and 11 years (inclusive) in the front seat
In both of the above cases

questions.comment: Children undoubtedly love to ride in the front seat of a car. But they should be allowed to do this, as required by the Rules, only with the use of appropriate child restraint systems (devices). (Clause 22.9 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: The owner of a vehicle is obliged to compensate for damage caused by this vehicle unless he proves that the damage occurred:

answers.text: Exclusively due to the intent of the victim
Due to force majeure or the intent of the victim

questions.comment: According to Article 1079 of the Civil Code of the Russian Federation, they can be considered both a consequence of force majeure and a consequence of the victim’s intent. “Civil Code of the Russian Federation.”

questions.question: When driving at night during a heavy snowstorm, the best visibility of the road is ensured by turning on

answers.text: Fog lights together with low beam headlights
Fog lights together with high beam headlights

questions.comment: Blizzards and fog create very dangerous driving conditions. When driving in such conditions, use low beam headlights. If there are fog lights, use them together. High beams are not used in snowstorms because they highlight the snow, which forms a “blinding wall of light” that reduces visibility of the road.

questions.question: In what cases should the victim be removed from the car?

answers.text: If there is a high probability of a vehicle rollover, fire, explosion, or if the victim loses consciousness

In case of a high probability of a car rollover, fire, explosion, hypothermia of the victim, in the absence of consciousness and breathing, as well as the impossibility of providing first aid directly inside the car
If there is a high risk of vehicle rollover, fire, explosion, or severe bleeding or traumatic brain injury

questions.comment: Only if resuscitation is necessary, i.e. in the absence of three signs of life in the victim, and this means loss of consciousness and the absence of a pulse in the carotid artery and signs of breathing, the victim must be removed from the car.

questions.question: In what form is the submission for verification of an insurance policy of compulsory civil liability insurance provided?

answers.text: In the form of an electronic document or its copy on paper
In any of the above types

questions.comment: According to the new paragraph of Rules 2.1.1(1) of the Traffic Regulations, the specified insurance policy can be provided by the driver on paper, and if such an agreement is concluded in the manner established by clause 72 of article and clause 15 of the Federal Insurance Law, in the form of an electronic document or a copy thereof on paper.

questions.question: This sign warns of approaching a tunnel in which:

answers.text: It will be difficult to pass oncoming vehicles
The traffic order is regulated by traffic lights

questions.comment: Sign 1.31 “Tunnel” warns of approaching a tunnel in which there is no artificial lighting, or a tunnel whose visibility of the entrance portal is limited. In tunnels, a moving vehicle must have high or low beam headlights on, regardless of whether the tunnel is illuminated. (“Road signs”, clause 19.1 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: You have the right to continue driving at the intersection:

answers.text: In all indicated directions except G

questions.comment: You can continue driving without violating the Rules in directions “A” and “B”. In direction “D” traffic is prohibited by sign 3.18.1 “Right turn prohibited”. Direction “B” passes along the roadway of oncoming traffic. Such movement is strictly prohibited. (Clause 1.4 of the Traffic Regulations, “Road Signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs allow you to turn left?
questions.comment: All signs allow you to turn left. Sign “A” - 3.19 “No U-turn” – allows you to turn left. Signs “B” and “C” also do not prohibit making a maneuver - turning left. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: If you have this marking on the traffic lane, you are allowed to:
questions.comment: Horizontal marking 1.18 allows left turns and U-turns from this lane. (“Horizontal markings”)

questions.question: You can move:
questions.comment: The right hand of the adjuster is extended forward. With this gesture of the adjuster from the left side, trackless vehicles are allowed to move in all directions – straight, right, left and turn.(Clause 6.10 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What external lighting devices must be turned on on a vehicle that has the “Transportation of Children” markings when boarding and disembarking children?

answers.text: Low beam headlights or fog lights

questions.comment: The hazard warning lights must be turned on when boarding and disembarking children on a bus that has identification signs “Transportation of Children.” (Clause 7.1 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: The driver of a car changing lane to the right lane in this situation:

answers.text: Must not interfere with a car moving in the right lane
Has an advantage because it completes overtaking
Has an advantage since the car has right turn indicators included

questions.comment: When changing lanes alone, the driver must give way to the “owner of the lane” - vehicles moving in the same direction without changing direction. (Clause 8.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Are you allowed to make a U-turn at the designated location?

answers.text: Permitted if road visibility is at least 100 m

questions.comment: There's a turn ahead. You can make a U-turn if the visibility of the road is at least 100 m. (Clause 8.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: At what maximum speed do you have the right to continue driving a car with a trailer?
questions.comment: On motorways this speed is 90 km/h, on other roads it is 70 km/h. The action, according to sign 5.1, takes place on the “Highway.” (Clause 10.3 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which trajectory can a motorcycle rider overtake?
questions.comment: Overtaking is prohibited at equivalent intersections. Therefore, the motorcycle driver can only overtake along trajectory “A” (clause 11.4).

questions.question: Are you allowed to stop at the indicated place?

answers.text: Allowed only for boarding or disembarking passengers

questions.comment: The left lane on the road, marked with sign 5.11.2 “Road with a lane for cyclists”, according to markings 1.23.3, is reserved for the movement of cyclists, mopeds and people using personal mobility devices towards the general flow of vehicles. Other vehicles are prohibited from driving along this lane and stopping on it. (Clauses 9.9, 12.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: You intend to drive straight through the intersection. What are your actions?

answers.text: You will pass first, guided by the traffic light signal.
You will pass first, following the “Main Road” sign.

questions.comment: The intersection is regulated by a traffic light. Priority signs don't work. You and the tram are in equal conditions. In such situations, a tram always has an advantage over trackless vehicles, so you give way to the tram. (Clause 13.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: What should you do when turning left?
questions.comment: The intersection is equal. Drivers of trackless vehicles are guided by the “right-hand rule” among themselves, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right gives way. You have an obstacle on the right, a passenger car passes first. (Clause 13.11 of the traffic rules)

questions.question: Who should you give way to when driving straight?
questions.comment: The intersection is unequal. The main road changes direction. Initially, vehicles on the main road pass through the intersection. They have an advantage. Between themselves they are guided by the “right hand rule”. You have an obstacle on the right, you are second only to a passenger car. (Clause 13.9, 13.10, 13.11 Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Did the driver violate the Rules during a forced stop on the highway?

answers.text: Violated by not displaying a warning triangle

questions.comment: The driver made a forced stop on the highway. To carry out repair work, he took the vehicle to a specially designated lane. According to paragraphs 16.2, 7.1, 7.2 of the traffic rules in the situation depicted, you should turn on the hazard warning lights and place a warning triangle at a distance of at least 30 m, because The action takes place outside the populated area.

questions.question: Is towing permitted in icy conditions if the towed vehicle has working brakes and steering?

answers.text: Allowed only with a rigid coupling or partial loading method

questions.comment: Towing in icy conditions using a flexible hitch is prohibited under any circumstances. Towing using the method of partial loading or using a rigid coupling is not prohibited. (Clause 20.4 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Is it allowed to install tires with anti-skid studs on a vehicle together with tires without anti-skid studs?
questions.comment: It is prohibited to install studded or studless tires on a vehicle. (“List of faults”, clause 5.2.)
topic: Malfunctions and conditions for admitting vehicles to operation

questions.question: When starting on a hill in a car with a manual transmission, you should begin to disengage (release) the parking brake:

answers.text: Simultaneously with the start of movement

questions.comment: The main condition when starting on a hill is to prevent rolling back. This is a problem for novice drivers who are incorrectly or insufficiently trained. Rolling back occurs if the parking brake is released before the vehicle begins to move. If you release the parking brake after you have started driving, the engine may stall. The correct answer is that the parking brake should be released simultaneously with the start of movement.

questions.question: What is meant by stopping route?

answers.text: The distance traveled by the vehicle from the moment the driver detects the danger until it comes to a complete stop
The distance traveled by the vehicle from the moment you press the brake pedal until it comes to a complete stop
The distance traveled by the vehicle from the moment the brake drive begins to operate until it comes to a complete stop

questions.comment: Stopping distance is the distance traveled by a vehicle from the moment the driver detects a danger until it comes to a complete stop. The stopping distance includes: the distance during the driver's reaction time plus the distance during the activation of the brake system, plus slowing down the vehicle to zero speed. (“Driving technology”)

questions.question: At the request of which persons it is necessary to transfer for verification a driver's license for the right to drive a vehicle of the corresponding category or subcategory and submit for verification an insurance policy of compulsory civil liability insurance on paper or in the form of an electronic document or a copy thereof on paper?

answers.text: Employee of the Military Automobile Inspectorate

questions.comment: Clause 2.1.1 of the traffic rules obliges the driver to perform the listed actions only at the request of a police officer.

questions.question: Are you allowed to continue driving at the intersection?
questions.comment: If sign 4.1.1 “Move straight ahead” is installed immediately before the intersection of roadways, traffic is only allowed straight ahead. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Which of the following signs permit a U-turn?
questions.comment: Mandatory signs, which include the sign A – 4.1.3 "Movement to the left", allowing a turn to the left, also allow a turn. Sign B – 5.7.2 "Exit to a one-way road" prohibits turning to the right, but does not prohibit turning. Most often, both drivers and traffic police officers either forget or do not know that the sign B – 3.18.2 "Left turn is prohibited" does not prohibit turning. Therefore, all three of these signs allow you to make a maneuver – a turn.(“Traffic Signs”)

questions.question: You can park in the parking lot using the method indicated on the plate:

answers.text: All vehicles except trucks with a permissible maximum weight of more than 3.5 tons

questions.comment: Plate 8.6.3 “Method of parking a vehicle” indicates how cars and motorcycles should be located on the edge of the sidewalk in the place indicated by sign 6.4 “Parking (parking space).” (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Markings in the form of the letter “A” indicate?

answers.text: Stopping and parking place for any buses

questions.comment: Horizontal marking 1.23.1 (in the form of the letter “A”) designates a special lane for route vehicles, which include buses and trolleybuses moving along established routes with designated stops. Minibus taxis do not fall into this category.

questions.question: Are you allowed to move?

answers.text: Allowed straight and to the right

questions.comment: Let us remember the aphorism “back is a wall”. You are prohibited from moving from the back. (Clause 6.10 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Traffic lights and traffic controller signals

questions.question: What identification mark must be attached to the rear of a towed motor vehicle if the hazard warning lights are missing or faulty?
questions.comment: “A” is an emergency stop sign. (Clause 7.3 of the Traffic Regulations)
topic: Use of hazard warning lights and warning triangles

questions.question: At the intersection you intend to turn right. What should you do?

answers.text: Change into the right lane, then make a turn
Continue in the left lane until the intersection, then turn

questions.comment: The effect of sign 5.15.1 “Directions of traffic along lanes” installed in front of the intersection applies to the entire intersection, unless other signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 installed on it give other instructions. Turning right is allowed from both lanes, so both options are acceptable. (“Road signs”)

questions.question: Who must give way when making a U-turn at the same time?

answers.text: In this situation, drivers should act by mutual agreement

questions.comment: In cases of determining the order of passage of vehicles not specified in the Rules, drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”, i.e. whoever has an obstacle on the right concedes. The bus driver has an obstacle on the right and gives way. (Clause 8.9 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: Which driver took the correct position in the lane?

answers.text: Only the driver of a moped occupying the left position in the lane
Only the driver of a motorcycle occupying the right position in the lane

questions.comment: Moped drivers must move along the right edge of the roadway in a single file. Motorcyclists can choose any lane to drive in a populated area, as long as a safe interval is ensured. The Rules do not prohibit them from moving along a lane in two rows. (Clause 9.4, 24.7 of the Traffic Rules)
topic: Location of vehicles on the roadway

questions.question: What should you do in this situation?

answers.text: Use the shoulder for oncoming traffic

questions.comment: Obstruction on the driver's side of the truck. He gives way, you go first.(Clause 11.7 of the Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Did the driver of the car violate the stopping rules?

answers.text: Violated if the distance from the car to the marking line is less than 3 m

questions.comment: At a T-shaped intersection, you can stop opposite the side passage, but it must have a continuous marking line or dividing strip. Here there is a marking of two lines - solid and broken. Stopping is therefore prohibited. (Clause 12.4 of traffic rules)

questions.question: You intend to turn right. What are your actions?

answers.text: Give way only to tram A
Give way only to tram B

questions.comment: With the simultaneous right to travel, trams have priority over trackless vehicles. (Clause 13.6 of the Traffic Regulations)

questions.question: When driving straight ahead you:

answers.text: Must give way only to motorcycles
Must give way only to cars
Must give way to both vehicles

questions.comment: The intersection is equal. A flashing orange or yellow light on a truck does not provide any advantage to its driver. Drivers are guided by the “right hand rule”. There is an obstacle on your right - a motorcyclist. You give way only to the motorcyclist who starts moving first and rolls out into the intersection. After this, you will pass through the intersection, a truck will follow you, the motorcyclist will be the last to finish moving. (Clause 3.4, 13.11 Traffic Rules)

questions.question: Who do you have to give way to when turning left?
questions.comment: In front of you is sign 2.4 “Give way.” Give way to vehicles moving along the road you are crossing, in this situation to both vehicles. (Clause 13.9 of the Traffic Regulations, “Road Signs”)

questions.question: Can you enter a railway crossing?

answers.text: Possible if there is no approaching train

questions.comment: The truck driver stopped to give way. Having arrived at a railway crossing, you will be forced to stop there, waiting for the space behind the crossing to become free. Traveling to a railway crossing in such a situation is prohibited. (Clause 15.3 of traffic rules)

questions.question: Is it permitted to transport people in a passenger car towing a disabled vehicle?

answers.text: Allowed only when towing with a rigid hitch

questions.comment: Clause 20.2 of the Traffic Regulations does not prohibit the transportation of people inside a passenger car towing a faulty vehicle, i.e., it is permitted.

questions.question: A driver for whom there are reasonable grounds to believe that he is intoxicated is sent for a medical examination for intoxication:

answers.text: If you refuse to undergo an alcohol intoxication test
If you disagree with the results of an alcohol intoxication test
If there are reasonable grounds to believe that the driver is intoxicated, and the test result for alcohol intoxication is negative
In all of the above cases

questions.comment: According to Art. 27.12 Part 1.1 of the Code of Administrative Offenses of the Russian Federation, in all of these cases the driver is sent for a medical examination to determine if he is intoxicated.

questions.question: What should a driver do when getting into a car parked at the sidewalk or on the side of the road?

answers.text: Walk around the front of the car
Walk around the car from behind

questions.comment: The Rules do not regulate this situation. In such a situation, you should perform actions that are more likely to ensure road safety. When boarding a car standing on the sidewalk or on the roadside, the driver should bypass it in front to constantly monitor the situation and see the vehicle moving in the same direction. The correct answer is to go around the front of the car.

questions.question: What is first aid if there are signs of a superficial thermal burn (redness and swelling of the skin, the formation of blisters filled with clear liquid at the burn site, severe pain)?

answers.text: Pour cold water over the burn surface, cover with a sterile cloth and bandage tightly
Open the burn blisters, clean the burn surface from remnants of clothing, cover with a sterile cloth (do not bandage), apply cold if possible, give the victim water to drink

Cool the burnt area with water for 20 minutes. Do not open burn blisters, do not remove remnants of clothing from the burned surface, cover the burn site with a sterile napkin (do not bandage), apply cold if possible and give the victim water to drink.

questions.comment: In case of burns, DO NOT open the blisters. Otherwise, a wound will form that becomes infected; do not remove any remaining clothing from the burned surface. The first step is to cool the burned wound with water for at least 20 minutes. Cover the burn site with a sterile cloth (do not bandage), apply cold if possible and give the victim water to drink.
